text: This project built a real, three-stage pipeline: T-SQL extraction, Python cleaning and joining, and Power BI modeling and reporting, feeding two stakeholder pages from one shared, reliable dataset.

T-SQL pulled two real extracts against AdventureWorks2012. Python removed duplicate rows, fixed inconsistent values, and merged the two extracts together. Power BI built a star schema, real CALCULATE plus ALL benchmark measures, and both pages.

Beyond the tools themselves, this project proved real skills: reasoning about which pipeline stage a task belongs in, and diagnosing a genuine bug with reproduce, isolate, confirm, fix, and validate, not guesswork.
Two stakeholders, one shared pipeline, built from data that didn't arrive clean, is an everyday shape of real Data Analyst and BI work. The Advanced project scales this same discipline up further.
Thornbury Cycle Supply Co.'s story continues in the Advanced project, with more stakeholders and new challenges ahead.
